ops.body: go.mod replaces github.com/yasyf/cc-interact with the RELATIVE sibling ../cc-interact (was an absolute /Users path; made portable + CI clones the sibling in commit 6d3effc). cc-runtime rides unpublished cc-interact daemon seams (ExtraHTTPListeners 017d82e, PublicHandler, HTTPInfo.ExtraAddrs, Server.Background, Origin-gated loopback bypass). Drop the replace and pin a published cc-interact release once the orchestrator ships it; until then cc-interact main must be pushed for cc-runtime CI to pass.
